newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tenaga gets nod to hive off units - paper.
newsitem.headline: Tenaga gets nod to hive off units - paper.

text.p: Malaysian utility Tenaga Nasional Bhd has received government approval to set up two wholly-owned units under a new group structure to take shape on September 1, Business Times daily said on Wednesday.
It quoted Tenaga executive chairman Ahmad Tajuddin Ali as saying the two units are Tenaga Nasional Generation Sdn Bhd and TNB Engineers Sdn Bhd.
Tenaga Nasional Generation will lease, operate and maintain 12 existing power plants owned by Tenaga, while TNB Engineers will provide energy and electricity consultancy.
Tajuddin told the daily that Tenaga as the holding company will retain the generation, transmission and distribution licence.
The company was hiving off the units to become a leaner and more agile outfit, he said.

"While we farm out the big generating plants, we will still be generating power through our small rural diesel stations which will remain a part of our distribution operations," he was quoted as saying.
TNB Engineers has already won some contracts from private power producers.

"We will provide a start-up capital to the company (TNB Engineers). From there, it can function and acquire business on its own, working on projects or supervising generation, distribution and transmission activities," he said.
Tenaga could not be immediately contacted for comment.
